faq.q: How long does the film last?
faq.a: Our films carry a lifetime warranty for the original owner. You can expect 10–15+ years of performance.

faq.q: Can I roll my windows down after tinting?
faq.a: We recommend waiting 3–5 days before rolling windows down to allow full curing.

faq.q: Will the film change how my home looks from outside?
faq.a: We offer neutral and low-reflectivity films designed to maintain your home's original appearance.

faq.q: How long does residential installation take?
faq.a: A typical home with 10–15 windows takes a single day. We clean up completely before leaving.

faq.q: Does film work on double-pane windows?
faq.a: Yes, with some limitations. We assess your specific glass type and recommend safe films to avoid seal failure.

faq.q: Can I get a custom decorative film?
faq.a: Absolutely. We offer frosted, patterned, and custom-cut privacy films for bathrooms and office partitions.
